If I could change the world in one way, it would be to eliminate misinformation and prejudice.

The spread of false information and harmful biases has a devastating impact on individuals and societies. It fuels conflict, undermines trust, and prevents us from addressing important challenges. By promoting critical thinking, media literacy, and empathy, we can create a world where people are empowered to make informed decisions and treat each other with respect.
